# Maintainer Label Reference

Core classification:
- bug
- enhancement
- feature
- breaking-change
- question
- docs
- dependency
- fix
- internal
- workflow

Auxiliary:
- needs-info
- stale
- auto-merge
- stable-conversion
- dependency-major
- dependency-minor
- dependency-patch
- dependency-lockfile

Canonical forms only. Do NOT add variants like "breaking change" (with space) or "documentation".
